headline: Fishermans Row Erupts as Flag Churn Sweeps Night Fronts
war_summary: Fishermans Row has become the night's storm centre: thirty-five flag events logged in twenty-four hours, nine inside the final two, the last minutes before this edition went to press. Arcadia, Eidolo and Black Well saw the sharpest churn, and every capture on the day's ledger there went to Colonial colours; all nine works now fly them, though bloodletting there runs light beside the great fronts. Marban Hollow registers one Warden work among eight after fresh fighting at Mox. The Weathered Expanse remains the costliest field, 9,600 Colonial and 12,900 Warden down in a day, Frostmarch and Crow's Nest trading flags to the wire while the five-to-four Colonial split holds. Callahan's Passage runs second in blood, better than 2,000 fallen in two hours with the pace still climbing, its ten works all Warden. Stlican Shelf stirred anew about Fort Hoarfrost — five Warden, three Colonial, one work in ruins — and Tempest Island logged brief flag work at Reef. The Dead Lands and Godcrofts, busy earlier, have gone quiet with their Colonial tallies intact. Our ledger counts 297 Colonial works to 138 Warden, one ruined. Day 248; no victor declared.
